case.question: I use ready-made two-sided vocabulary cards with a drawing and a Korean word. Two card recall drills in 100 seconds total, both from the drawing to the word. After checking, leave each card ready for the next pass.
case.expected: Two timed drills total ≤100s. Drawing prompt makes learner produce Korean first, each card checked then reset drawing-up, no guessed definitions or alternate deck.

models.answer:
1. Drawing-to-Korean recall, full deck pass (50 seconds): shuffle the ready-made cards, then for each card place it drawing-side up, say the Korean word without looking, flip once to check, and immediately return that card drawing-side up so it is ready for the next pass; if you finish the deck early, stop rather than adding a second round.

2. Drawing-to-Korean recall, second full pass (50 seconds): reshuffle the same cards, then for each card place it drawing-side up, say the Korean word without looking, flip once to check, and immediately return that card drawing-side up so it is ready for the next pass; if you finish early, stop rather than adding extra rounds.

Drawing-to-Korean recall, full deck pass (50 seconds): shuffle the ready-made cards, then for each card place it drawing-side up, say the Korean word without looking, flip once to check, and immediately return that card drawing-side up so it is ready for the next pass; if you finish the deck early, stop rather than adding a second round.

Drawing-to-Korean recall, second full pass (50 seconds): reshuffle the same cards, then for each card place it drawing-side up, say the Korean word without looking, flip once to check, and immediately return that card drawing-side up so it is ready for the next pass; if you finish early, stop rather than adding extra rounds.

case.question: 可以慢拧魔方了，给两项练习。若复现不了那个熟悉局面，每项给不同的备用练法，都写明各用多久。
case.expected: Two activities with positive allocations combined ≤200s inherited. In each give distinct concrete executable known-turn fallback, separate from verified insertion; no invented algorithm/mandatory slot checks.

history.content: 我有三分二十秒，暂时不转动魔方。我想从一个学过的插入局面练起，但不一定摆得出它。
先观察眼前的状态，保持魔方不动。

inputs.quote: 我想从一个学过的插入局面练起，但不一定摆得出它。
可以慢拧魔方了，给两项练习。

activities.title: 熟悉插入局面复现与慢拧

steps.action: 选定一个自己学过的插入，用它的逆操作在当前魔方上尝试摆出该熟悉局面，并目视确认局面和目标槽位；确认后做一次该插入，再用同一逆操作复位同一局面并重复；若摆不出熟悉局面，则改为慢拧自己已知的转法，每转一步停一下，观察哪一块可见地移动了，不声称完成F2L。
steps.reason: 先验证熟悉局面再插入，摆不出时用已知慢拧保持可控练习。

activities.title: 预测一步变化与分支练习

steps.action: 选定同一个学过的插入，用它的逆操作尝试摆出熟悉局面并目视确认局面和目标槽位；确认后做一次该插入，再用同一逆操作复位同一局面并重复；若摆不出熟悉局面，则改为慢拧已知转法，在转一步之前先预测哪一块会可见地移动，转完后对照实际移动，不声称完成F2L。
steps.reason: 用预测对比加深对已知转法的观察，同时保留已验证局面的插入练习。

case.question: 我只会 L 和 D2，不会插入。两项慢拧训练合计最多一分四十五秒，每项不超过六十秒。每做一步，就停下来指出受影响的一面。
case.expected: Two timed activities ≤105s overall and ≤60s each. L/D2 only, pause and identify a legitimately affected face after every move, no invented setup/insertions.

inputs.quote: 我只会 L 和 D2，不会插入。
每做一步，就停下来指出受影响的一面。
两项慢拧训练合计最多一分四十五秒，每项不超过六十秒。

activities.title: 慢拧 L 并观察受影响面

steps.action: 先缓慢做一次 L，停住，指出受影响的一面；再缓慢做一次 L，停住，指出受影响的一面；重复到时间结束，最后检查是否每次都在动作后停下并指出了一面。
steps.reason: 只用已会的 L 慢拧并每步停顿观察，符合不会插入且需指出受影响面的要求。

activities.title: 慢拧 D2 并观察受影响面

steps.action: 先缓慢做一次 D2，停住，指出受影响的一面；再缓慢做一次 D2，停住，指出受影响的一面；重复到时间结束，最后检查是否每次都在动作后停下并指出了一面。
steps.reason: 只用已会的 D2 慢拧并每步停顿观察，不引入插入或其他公式。

case.question: Make a 140–170-word English plan to practise with my existing two-column list of Swedish words and meanings. I have 3 minutes. Use two activities with two timed substeps each, including a reason in each substep.
case.expected: 140–170 whitespace words, 2×2 child and parent sums ≤180s, reason per substep, reuse table; only current answer column hidden for each attempt and restored after check.

inputs.quote: my existing two-column list of Swedish words and meanings

steps.action: Keep the Swedish column visible, cover the meaning column, and recall each meaning in order; if the list has fewer items than expected, work through every item once and stop early rather than inventing entries.
steps.reason: Recalling from the visible Swedish prompt builds receptive vocabulary and uses the full existing list.

steps.action: Uncover the meaning column and check each recalled meaning, marking misses; if there are no misses, note that the list was fully correct.
steps.reason: Checking against the reference reveals which meanings need another pass.

steps.action: Cover the Swedish column, keep meanings visible, and say the Swedish word for each meaning, prioritising marked misses first; if none were marked, use the whole list.
steps.reason: Producing words from meanings strengthens productive recall and targets weak items.

steps.action: Uncover the Swedish column and compare each spoken attempt, noting any remaining gaps; if all were correct, finish with a clean pass.
steps.reason: Comparing attempts against the list confirms which words are now secure.
